about: Vallado's SGP4 verification set (SGP4-VER.TLE, tcppver.out) against propagator/sgp4: TEME km and km/s at every time tcppver.out prints. Generated by run-vallado.mjs; rows explained in its header.

native.emcc: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 4.0.23-git

wasmRefusals.message: ingest_omm failed to apply any OMM records.

module.rationale: The same fixed agreement limits apply to shipped WASM against native improved-mode Vallado at the same effective minutes since epoch. The elements, build, emccFast and emccStrict controlled subtractions isolate initialization and compiler arithmetic; their observed spread does not raise the limit. No printed reference rows exist at these perturbed times.

source.rationale: The identical pinned Vallado algorithm, WGS-72 constants and improved operation mode isolate native floating-point evaluation against the printed states. Fixed 1 mm and 10 micrometres/s agreement limits assess that evaluation; the 5 micrometre position component printing envelope is a separate diagnostic.

wasm.formula: norm(W-P) <= norm(Veffective-Vintended) + norm(W-Veffective) + sqrt(3)*printingComponentHalfStep, evaluated independently for position and velocity at every sample
wasm.rationale: The per-sample bound has no acceptance epsilon. The exact vector identity is W-P=module+timeOnly+source, so the two-subtraction bound with printing alone is conditional on native-source-versus-print agreement within the printing envelope. Exceedances retain the measured source residual as their cause; the allowance is not enlarged.

provenance.reference: Authenticated SGP4-VER.TLE and tcppver.out; strict native source and shipped WASM identified by the unchanged summary pins.
